mapper.select: /*getLogin*/ SELECT A.USER_ID AS USERID , A.PASSWORD, A.STATUS, A.USER_TYPE AS USERTYPE, A.CHANGE_USER_TYPE AS CHANGEUSERTYPE, A.COM_TYPE AS COMTYPE, B.BUSINESS_COND AS BUSINESSCOND, A.COM_CODE AS COMCODE, A.LOGIN_ERROR_CNT AS LOGINERRORCNT, A.PASSWORD_TYPE AS PASSWORD_TYPE, NVL(A.TWO_FACTOR_YN,'X') AS TWO_FACTOR_YN, NVL(B.DELY_AREA,'X') AS DELY_AREA, B.STATUS AS CMPY_STATUS, CASE WHEN PASSWORD_TYPE = 'T' THEN 'IMSI' ELSE CASE WHEN PASSWORD_TYPE = 'C' AND SYSDATE > (TO_DATE(NVL(PASS_CHANGE_DATE,'20000101'),'YYYYMMDD')+90) THEN 'OLD' ELSE CASE WHEN PASSWORD_TYPE = 'C' AND SYSDATE < (TO_DATE(NVL(PASS_CHANGE_DATE,'20000101'),'YYYYMMDD')+90) THEN 'OK' END END END AS PWD_STATUS FROM ICOMLUSR A, ICOMCMPY B WHERE USER_ID = #{value} AND A.COM_CODE = B.COM_CODE AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND B.STATUS != 'D' AND NVL(TRIM(B.COM_TYPE),B.BUSINESS_COND) <> 'X'

/*getSessionInfo*/ SELECT A.USER_ID as userId , A.USER_NAME_LOC as userNameLoc, A.EMAIL as email, A.MOBILE_PHONE as mPhone, A.ROLE role, -- A:관리자,C:발주+입고, G:입고, P:발주, U:요청, U-:요청제한 (SELECT AUTH_ID FROM KX_USERAUTH WHERE USER_ID = A.USER_ID ) AS userAuth, A.COM_TYPE as comType, A.USER_TYPE as userType, A.COM_CODE as comCode, -- buyer A.DEPARTMENT department, A.POSITION position, A.IMG_VIEW_FLAG imgViewFlag, A.FAX_NUMBER fax, A.PHONE_NUMBER tel, A.USER_NAME_ENG userNameEng, A.COUNTRY country, (SELECT D.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 D WHERE D.COMPANY_CODE=A.COM_CODE AND D.TYPE='C001' AND D.CODE=A.DEPARTMENT) departmentName, A.STATUS status, A.DELY_TO_LOCATION delyToLocation, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE CODE = A.DELY_TO_LOCATION AND COMPANY_CODE = A.COM_CODE AND TYPE = 'C012') delyToLocationCodeName, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE CODE = A.DELY_TO_LOCATION AND COMPANY_CODE = A.COM_CODE AND TYPE = 'C012') delyToLocationName, A.PURCHASE_DEPT purchaseDept, (SELECT D.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 D WHERE D.COMPANY_CODE=A.COM_CODE AND D.TYPE='C001' AND D.CODE=A.PURCHASE_DEPT) purchaseDeptName, A.ZIP_CODE zipCode, A.PERSON_AUTHOR personAuthor, A.ROW_CNT rowCnt, DECODE(NVL(A.OFFICE_YN,'N'),'Y','B',B.BUSINESS_COND) as businessCond, B.USING_CATAL_TYPE usingCatalType, B.BYCA_COMORG_CODE bycaComorgCode, B.BUDGET_FLAG budgetFlag, B.COM_NAME_ENG comNameEng, B.COM_NAME_LOC comNameLoc, B.ADDRESS_LOC addressLoc, B.HP_ADDRESS hpAddress, B.AGENT_OPEN_FLAG agentOpenFlag, B.BYCA_COMORG_LEVEL bycaComorgLevel, A.USER_GROUP userGroup, CASE WHEN PASSWORD_TYPE = 'T' THEN 'IMSI' ELSE CASE WHEN PASSWORD_TYPE = 'C' AND SYSDATE > (TO_DATE(NVL(PASS_CHANGE_DATE,'20000101'),'YYYYMMDD')+90) THEN 'OLD' ELSE CASE WHEN PASSWORD_TYPE = 'C' AND SYSDATE < (TO_DATE(NVL(PASS_CHANGE_DATE,'20000101'),'YYYYMMDD')+90) THEN 'OK' END END END AS pwdStatus, NVL(DECODE(B.LOGO_YN,'Y','/resources/images/ci/'||B.COM_CODE||'.gif'),'/resources/images/b_h1_logo.gif') AS ciImage, NVL(A.WAREHOUSE_ADMIN,'N') AS whAdmin, PASSWORD password, (SELECT PASSWORD FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = 'O'||A.USER_ID) AS decode_password, -- 운영사인대 고객사로 로그인 가능자 암호 디코드 (SELECT OFFICE_YN FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = 'O'||A.USER_ID) office_yn, -- 운영사인대 고객사로 로그인 가능자 A.REJECT_REASON as ikenSessionkey, A.ACCESS_COMORG_LEVEL as accessComorgLevel, A.LEGACY_USER_ID AS empNo, A.LANG AS lang, A.PASSWORD_TYPE AS passwordType, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(NVL(A.LAST_LOGIN_DATE||A.LAST_LOGIN_TIME,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') AS lastLoginDate, NVL(A.TWO_FACTOR_YN,'X') AS twoFactorYn, A.CHG_INFO_PWD_YN AS chgInfoPwdYn, A.PR_MNG_FLAG AS prMngFlag, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = A.COM_CODE AND TYPE = 'ADMIP' AND CODE = A.USER_ID AND FLAG = 'Y') AS kepAdmIpList, NVL(A.OFFICE_YN,'N') AS ownOfficeYn FROM ICOMLUSR A, ICOMCMPY B WHERE USER_ID = #{value} AND A.COM_CODE = B.COM_CODE AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND B.STATUS != 'D' AND NVL(TRIM(B.COM_TYPE),B.BUSINESS_COND) <> 'X'
/*getOldPasswordCheck*/ SELECT CASE WHEN #{st_old_password} = PASSWORD THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS FLAG FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: /*setUserPwdUpdate*/ UPDATE ICOMLUSR SET PASSWORD = #{st_password}, PASS_CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), PASSWORD_TYPE = 'C' WHERE USER_ID IN (SELECT CODE2 FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE TYPE = 'UNID' AND CODE1 = #{userId} AND FLAG = 'Y' UNION SELECT #{userId} FROM DUAL)

/*setPunchoutRollInsert*/ INSERT INTO KX_USERAUTH ( USER_ID, AUTH_ID, CREATE_DT, USE_FLAG )VALUES ( #{appUserName}, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE ='M140' AND CODE = #{comcode}), SYSDATE, 'Y' )

/*setPunchoutAdminRollInsert*/ INSERT INTO KX_USERAUTH ( USER_ID, AUTH_ID, CREATE_DT, USE_FLAG )VALUES ( #{appUserName}, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE ='M146' AND CODE = #{comcode}), SYSDATE, 'Y' )

/*setPunchoutUserInsert*/ INSERT INTO ICOMLUSR (USER_ID, COM_TYPE, USER_TYPE, PASSWORD, LANG, USER_NAME_ENG, USER_NAME_LOC, COM_CODE, EMAIL, COUNTRY, REG_DATE, STATUS, PERSON_AUTHOR, BEGIN_DATE, PASS_CHANGE_DATE, USER_GROUP, CONFIRM_DATE, CONFIRM_USER_ID, LEGACY_USER_ID, ROLE, MAIL_RECV_FLAG, ACCESS_COMORG_LEVEL, SMS_RECV_FLAG, ROW_CNT, IMG_VIEW_FLAG, PASSWORD_TYPE, PR_MNG_FLAG, RETURN_URL )VALUES( TRIM(#{appUserName}), 'B', 'A', #{password} 'KR', #{appUserName}, #{userName}, #{comcode}, #{userEmail}, 'KR', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), 'C', 'PO', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), 'C', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), 'PUNCHOUT', #{appUserName}, 'A+', 'N', '2', 'N', '10', 'Y', 'C', 'N', #{returnURL} )
mapper.select: /*getUserPrtysByUserId*/ SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR (PRTY_VALUES, '[^;]+', 1, lv) AS ROLE_ID FROM (SELECT USER_ID, LTRIM (RTRIM (PRTY_VALUE, ';'), ';') AS PRTY_VALUES FROM KX_USERPRTY WHERE USE_FLAG = 'Y' AND PRTY_KEY= 'ROLE_LIST' AND USER_ID = #{userId}) t, ( SELECT LEVEL lv FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 20) WHERE LENGTH (PRTY_VALUES) - LENGTH (REPLACE (PRTY_VALUES, ';')) + 1 >= lv

/*getRedirectUrlByUserId*/ SELECT Y.URL||CHR(63)||'upperId='||Y.TOPMENUID AS URL FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN INSTR (B.COL01_DATA, #{USER_ID}) > 0 OR B.COL01_DATA = 'ALL' THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(COL02_DATA, CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '') WHEN INSTR (B.COL03_DATA, #{USER_ID}) > 0 OR B.COL01_DATA = 'ALL' THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(COL04_DATA, CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '') ELSE NULL END FRST_MENU_ID, B.IMP_NOTE FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND B.COM_CODE = #{COM_CODE} AND A.SLG_ID = 'P07-0000020' ) X, (SELECT B.MENU_ID, B.NAME, B.DEPTH, B.TYPE, B.URL, DECODE(SUBSTR(B.MENU_ID, 0, 1), 'b', 'b00100000000', DECODE(B.DEPTH, 0,B.MENU_ID, 1,B.MENU_ID, 2,B.UPPER_ID, 3,(SELECT UPPER_ID FROM KX_MENUINFO WHERE MENU_ID = B.UPPER_ID), 4,(SELECT UPPER_ID FROM KX_MENUINFO WHERE MENU_ID = B.UPPER_ID) )) AS TOPMENUID FROM KX_MENUAUTH A, KX_MENUINFO B WHERE A.MENU_ID = B.MENU_ID AND A.AUTH_ID = (SELECT AUTH.AUTH_ID AS AUTHID FROM KX_AUTHINFO AUTH, KX_USERAUTH USERAUTH WHERE AUTH.AUTH_ID = USERAUTH.AUTH_ID AND USERAUTH.USER_ID = #{USER_ID} ) AND A.USE_FLAG = 'Y' AND B.USE_FLAG = 'Y') Y WHERE X.FRST_MENU_ID = Y.MENU_ID

/*setCowayIkenSsoId*/ SELECT USER_ID FROM ( SELECT NVL (TRIM (USER_ID), '') AS USER_ID ,NVL(B.VALUE1,99) AS IDX FROM ICOMLUSR A LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMCOD2 B ON (1 = 1 AND B.TYPE = 'C001' AND B.CODE = A.DEPARTMENT AND B.COMPANY_CODE = A.COM_CODE ) WHERE 1=1 AND A.COM_CODE LIKE SUBSTR(#{COM_CODE},1,6)||'%' AND A.LEGACY_USER_ID = #{EMP_NO} AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND (A.OFFICE_YN IS NULL OR A.OFFICE_YN <> 'Y' ) ORDER BY IDX, COM_CODE DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

/* setGroupIkenSsoId */ SELECT USER_ID FROM ( SELECT NVL (TRIM (USER_ID), '') AS USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR A , ICOMCMPY C WHERE 1=1 AND C.BYCA_COMORG_CODE = #{COM_CODE} AND C.COM_CODE = A.COM_CODE AND A.LEGACY_USER_ID = #{EMP_NO} AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') UNION SELECT NVL (TRIM (USER_ID), '') AS USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR A WHERE 1=1 AND A.COM_CODE IN (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE IN ('C002','PLNT') AND COMPANY_CODE = #{COM_CODE} AND FLAG = 'Y') AND A.LEGACY_USER_ID = #{EMP_NO} AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') UNION SELECT NVL (TRIM (C.USER_ID), '') AS USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR C WHERE 1 = 1 AND C.COM_CODE IN (SELECT TEXT4 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M127' AND TEXT1 = #{COM_CODE} AND FLAG = 'Y') AND C.LEGACY_USER_ID = #{EMP_NO} AND C.STATUS IN ('C','R') ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

/*setIkenSsoId*/ SELECT USER_ID FROM ( SELECT NVL (TRIM (A.USER_ID), '') AS USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR A WHERE A.COM_CODE = #{COM_CODE} AND A.LEGACY_USER_ID = #{EMP_NO} AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND (A.OFFICE_YN IS NULL OR A.OFFICE_YN <> 'Y' ) UNION SELECT NVL (TRIM (C.USER_ID), '') AS USER_ID FROM ICOMCMPY B , ICOMLUSR C WHERE B.BYCA_COMORG_CODE = #{COM_CODE} AND B.STATUS != 'D' AND C.COM_CODE = B.COM_CODE AND C.LEGACY_USER_ID = #{EMP_NO} AND C.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND (C.OFFICE_YN IS NULL OR C.OFFICE_YN <> 'Y' ) ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT TEXT2 AS DOMAIN, TEXT3 AS ATTR1, TEXT4 AS ATTR2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M127' AND TEXT1 = #{comCode} AND FLAG = 'Y'
mapper.update: /*saveLogintime1*/ UPDATE ICOMLUSR SET LAST_LOGIN_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , LAST_LOGIN_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') , LOGIN_ERROR_CNT = 0 , TWO_FACTOR_SMS = NULL WHERE USER_ID = #{LAST_LOGIN_ID1} AND STATUS IN ('C', 'R')
mapper.select: /*selectPasswordShaUserInfo*/ SELECT MAKER_NAME AS USER_ID ,ORIGIN_CODE AS PWD FROM HMH_TMP
mapper.update: /*saveIcomcmpyInfoUpdate*/ UPDATE ICOMCMPY SET TEL_NO = #{st_tel_no1} || '-' || #{st_tel_no2} || '-' || #{st_tel_no3}, FAX_NO = #{st_fax_no1} || '-' || #{st_fax_no2} || '-' || #{st_fax_no3}, ADDRESS_LOC = #{st_address} || ' ' || #{st_address_dt}, ADDRESS_LOC1 = #{st_address}, ADDRESS_LOC2 = #{st_address_dt}, ZIP_KEY = #{st_zip_key}, ZIP_CODE = #{st_zip_code}, GR_EMP_NM = #{st_gr_emp_nm}, GR_EMP_EMAIL = #{st_gr_emp_email}, GR_EMP_TEL = #{st_gr_emp_tel_no1} || '-' || #{st_gr_emp_tel_no2} || '-' || #{st_gr_emp_tel_no3}, GR_EMP_MOBILE = #{st_gr_emp_mobile1} || '-' || #{st_gr_emp_mobile2} || '-' || #{st_gr_emp_mobile3}, AC_EMP_NM = #{st_ac_emp_nm}, AC_EMP_EMAIL = #{st_ac_emp_email}, AC_EMP_TEL = #{st_ac_emp_tel_no1} || '-' || #{st_ac_emp_tel_no2} || '-' || #{st_ac_emp_tel_no3}, AC_EMP_MOBILE = #{st_ac_emp_mobile1} || '-' || #{st_ac_emp_mobile2} || '-' || #{st_ac_emp_mobile3}, CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE COM_CODE = #{comCode}

/*saveIcomlusrInfoUpdate*/ UPDATE ICOMLUSR SET USER_NAME_LOC = #{st_user_nm}, PHONE_NUMBER = #{st_user_phone1}||'-'||#{st_user_phone2}||'-'||#{st_user_phone3}, EMAIL = #{st_user_email}, MOBILE_PHONE = #{st_user_mobile1}||'-'||#{st_user_mobile2}||'-'||#{st_user_mobile3}, INFO_UPDATE_YN =#{infoUpdateYn}, INFO_UPDATE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: /* selectLoginInfoList */ SELECT CM.COM_NAME_LOC, CM.COM_CODE, CM.IRS_NO, CM.CEO_NAME_LOC, CM.TEL_NO, CM.FAX_NO, CM.ZIP_KEY, CM.ZIP_CODE, CM.ADDRESS_LOC, NVL(CM.ADDRESS_LOC1, CM.ADDRESS_LOC) AS ADDRESS_LOC1, CM.ADDRESS_LOC2, CM.GR_EMP_NM, CM.GR_EMP_EMAIL, CM.GR_EMP_TEL, CM.GR_EMP_MOBILE, CM.AC_EMP_NM, CM.AC_EMP_EMAIL, CM.AC_EMP_TEL, CM.AC_EMP_MOBILE, AN.BANK_CD, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE CODE = AN.BANK_CD AND TYPE = 'M005') AS BANK_NAME, AN.BANK_ACCOUNT_NO, AN.DEPOSITOR, USR.USER_ID, USR.USER_NAME_LOC, USR.PHONE_NUMBER, USR.MOBILE_PHONE, USR.EMAIL AS USR_EMAIL, USR.USER_TYPE FROM ICOMCMPY CM, ICOMLUSR USR, ACNTSUPL AN WHERE 1=1 AND CM.COM_CODE = USR.COM_CODE AND CM.COM_CODE = AN.SUPPLIER AND USR.USER_ID = #{st_user_id}

/*getIdValidCheck*/ SELECT CASE WHEN A.STATUS = 'S' THEN 'S' WHEN A.STATUS = 'A' AND A.USER_TYPE = 'A' AND A.CHANGE_USER_TYPE = 'A' THEN 'A' WHEN #{password} <> A.PASSWORD THEN 'P' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOGPASSLN WHERE COMPANY = A.COM_CODE AND DOCU_NO = #{gw_no} AND USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND PASS_TP IN ('1', '3') AND PASS_KN IS NULL) = 0 THEN 'G' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOGPASSLN WHERE COMPANY = A.COM_CODE AND DOCU_NO = #{gw_no} AND USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND PASS_TP IN ('1', '3') AND ORDER_NO = (SELECT CUR_ORDER_NO FROM ICOGDOCU WHERE COMPANY = A.COM_CODE AND DOCU_NO = #{gw_no})) = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS FLAG FROM ICOMLUSR A WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId}

/*getTwoFactorYn*/ SELECT NVL(B.BUSINESS_COND,'X') || NVL(A.TWO_FACTOR_YN,'X') AS TWO_FACTOR_YN FROM ICOMLUSR A, ICOMCMPY B WHERE A.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND A.COM_CODE = B.COM_CODE AND A.STATUS IN ('C', 'R') AND B.STATUS IN ('C', 'R')
/*getOldCertSmsCheck*/ SELECT CASE WHEN #{st_cert_sms_no} = TWO_FACTOR_SMS THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS FLAG FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: /*saveLoginHist*/ INSERT INTO MRO_LOGIN ( LOGIN_DATE, USER_ID, IP, IP2, TERMINAL, OS_USER, LOGIN_TYPE, TWO_FACTOR_YN ) ( SELECT SYSDATE, #{USER_ID}, #{IP}, #{IP2}, SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','TERMINAL',30), SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','OS_USER',30), #{LOGIN_TYPE}, #{TWO_FACTOR_YN} FROM DUAL )
mapper.select: /*setCodIkenKumhSsoId*/ SELECT USER_ID FROM ( SELECT USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.COM_CODE IN ( SELECT COD.CODE2 FROM ICOMCOD3 COD WHERE COD.TYPE ='SSO' AND COD.CODE1 = #{COM_CODE} AND COD.FLAG = 'Y' ) AND STATUS != 'D' AND USR.LEGACY_USER_ID = #{EMP_NO} ORDER BY EXPIRE_DATE DESC NULLS LAST ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

/* selectLoginInfoImsiList */ SELECT X.COM_NAME_LOC, X.COM_CODE, X.USER_ID, X.USER_NAME_LOC, X.PHONE_NUMBER, X.MOBILE_PHONE, X.USR_EMAIL, X.USER_TYPE, X.BUSINESS_COND, X.PRIORITY_USER, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = X.PRIORITY_USER) AS PRIORITY_USER_NAME, (SELECT PHONE_NUMBER FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = X.PRIORITY_USER) AS PRIORITY_USER_NUMBER, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND TYPE = 'C001' AND CODE = X.TEAM) AS PRIORITY_USER_TEAM FROM ( SELECT CM.COM_NAME_LOC, CM.COM_CODE, USR.USER_ID, USR.USER_NAME_LOC, USR.PHONE_NUMBER, USR.MOBILE_PHONE, USR.EMAIL AS USR_EMAIL, USR.USER_TYPE, CM.BUSINESS_COND, (SELECT MAX(KEP_USER_ID) FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG WHERE YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND STATUS = 'C' AND BUYER = CM.COM_CODE AND PRIORITY = 'Y') AS PRIORITY_USER, (SELECT MAX(KEP_DEPT) FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG WHERE YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND STATUS = 'C' AND BUYER = CM.COM_CODE AND PRIORITY = 'Y') AS TEAM FROM ICOMCMPY CM, ICOMLUSR USR WHERE 1=1 AND CM.COM_CODE = USR.COM_CODE AND USR.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} ) X
